capability.purpose: Establish the actual read-only state of a repository before planning, continuation, recovery, or implementation.

inputs.name: repository_scope
inputs.description: Repository or workspace whose current state must be established.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: Current project objective or decision that makes repository truth relevant.

inputs.name: status_claims
inputs.description: Existing completion, branch, roadmap, or handoff claims to verify.

outputs.name: current_state_report
outputs.description: Evidence-backed repository state, claim comparison, drift, risks, and validation results.

outputs.name: continuation_point
outputs.description: Exact defensible point from which planning or execution should continue.

preconditions.description: The repository or equivalent inspectable workspace is available within scope.

requirements.description: Important status claims are compared against repository evidence.
Performed, skipped, unavailable, and unverified checks are distinguished.
The audit does not intentionally mutate repository state.

evidence_outputs.name: repository_truth_report
evidence_outputs.description: Inspectable current-state report with evidence and uncertainty.

evidence_outputs.name: continuation_point
evidence_outputs.description: Grounded next work boundary rather than a guessed plan.

compatibility.notes: Public display name is independent of the canonical asset ID agent.repository-truth-audit.
